seo.metaDescription: Zoho ERP and CRM services for growing firms: advisory, implementation, integration, migration and managed support from Linkfields.
seo.keywords: Zoho ERP, Zoho CRM, Zoho implementation, Customer 360

sections.title: Zoho
sections.subtitle: Agile platforms for growing firms. Connected ERP and CRM journeys.

sections.heading: Bring operations and customer engagement together
sections.body:
Zoho ERP and CRM help growing firms connect the way they operate with the way they engage customers. Linkfields combines platform advisory, implementation and ongoing support to shape a solution around your priorities.

Zoho is one of our listed technology partners. Our Intelligent Enterprise Platforms services bring an ERP and Customer 360 perspective to the journey, from requirements and configuration to adoption and optimisation.

cards.title: ERP planning
cards.description: Map the operational processes and priorities that your Zoho ERP programme needs to support.

cards.title: CRM journeys
cards.description: Shape sales and customer service journeys around a shared view of the customer.

cards.title: Configuration
cards.description: Align workflows and business rules with the way your organisation works.

cards.title: System integration
cards.description: Connect ERP and CRM processes with the wider enterprise landscape.

cards.title: Data migration
cards.description: Plan data mapping, cleansing and validation before moving to the new platform.

cards.title: Managed support
cards.description: Keep the platform aligned to changing business needs through support and optimisation.

sections.title: Connect your next stage of growth

cards.title: Business process design
cards.description: Review your processes and define how Zoho ERP and CRM will support the business.

cards.title: Configuration & development
cards.description: Configure the agreed workflows and develop extensions where the requirements call for them.

cards.title: System integration
cards.description: Design the connections between Zoho and the systems your teams already use.

cards.title: Data migration & management

sections.heading: A practical route from discovery to adoption

items.title: Assess & plan
items.description: Understand business goals, current processes and the CRM journeys that matter. Agree a roadmap, delivery scope and acceptance criteria.

items.title: Configure & integrate
items.description: Configure the agreed ERP and CRM workflows, build the required connections and prepare data for migration.

items.title: Validate & enable
items.description: Test end-to-end processes and migrated data with business users. Provide training and a clear plan for adoption.

items.title: Launch & optimise
items.description: Manage the transition into service, resolve issues and prioritise improvements as your organisation grows.
